verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents a substantial programmatic surface: a published OpenAPI v1 spec, sessions that can be created, controlled and observed programmatically, a Downloads API, and webhooks that can be managed through either Settings or the SDK and act on the same objects. However, several features are documented only in the dashboard: Agents are created there and the Optimize tool lives in the dashboard run view, with no API equivalent shown, so full UI parity is not demonstrated. The 404s at the standard OpenAPI paths are explained by the spec being published at /reference/api/openapi.v1.yaml and are not a contradiction. Missing for 10: API equivalents for dashboard-only Agent creation and the Optimize tool, an explicit statement of API/UI parity, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
